nodes.label: Full Table Scan
nodes.description: LIKE-match scan over the entire tweet table — too slow at scale.

nodes.label: Tweet Write
nodes.description: A new tweet enters the system.

nodes.label: Indexing Pipeline
nodes.description: Tokenizes the tweet and updates the inverted index near-real-time.

nodes.label: Inverted Index
nodes.description: term → tweet IDs. Query time depends on postings-list size, not corpus size.

nodes.label: Search Query
nodes.description: Tokenized the same way, looked up directly against the index.

nodes.label: Tweet Stream
nodes.description: Same underlying write stream, consumed independently from search indexing.

nodes.label: Windowed Term Counter
nodes.description: Stream processor maintaining sliding-window mention counts per term.

nodes.label: Top-K Cache
nodes.description: Cached current trending list, served directly to clients.
